articles.summary: MELBOURNE, Fla. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Feb. 20, 2026-- BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT) announced today that Dan Jablonsky has been appointed to its board of directors effective March 2, 2026. He will also serve on the board’s audit and finance committee. This press release features multimedia.
articles.title: BWXT Appoints Dan Jablonsky to Board of Directors
